# Tomorrow, 10 November: Rain in Da Nang, temperatures lower than today

Published : -

Font Size:

## Sunny in Hanoi, slightly cool in the evening

On Tuesday, 10 November, sunny weather is forecast in Hanoi, with a 10% chance of rain. The low is forecast to be 16°C, within the slightly cold range for northern Vietnam, while the high will be 22°C. The high is lower than today, while the low is about the same. [...] The low is 23°C and the high is 25°C. Both are lower than today. The temperature is forecast to be around 24°C in the evening. The mosquito index indicates high mosquito activity, so take full precautions when going out.

## Sunny in Ho Chi Minh City, with a chance of afternoon rain

Sunny weather with occasional rain is forecast in Ho Chi Minh City on 10 November, with a 50% chance of rain. Rain is forecast in the afternoon, with a 90% chance, so bring an umbrella if you plan to go out then. [...] The low is 26°C and the high is 33°C, in the range of intense heat. The high is about the same as today. The temperature is forecast to be around 27°C in the evening. The WBGT index is at a high-caution level for the risk of heat stress. The mosquito index indicates that mosquitoes may be present, so be prepared as needed.

Cloudy
